Author: Sharad Kumar Sharma
Bench: Sharad Kumar Sharma

S  directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  IA No.03 of 2023 (Compounding Application)
 With  C482 No.1896 of 2021  Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Raj Kumar Singh, Advocate, for the applicants.
Mrs. Lata Negi, Brief Holder, for the State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Akshay Pradhan, Advocate, for the respondent.

This C482 application is listed today for consideration of the compounding application, as it has been jointly preferred by the parties to the C482 application, along with the respective affidavits filed in support thereto.

The precise facts of the case are that proceedings by way of registration of the FIR No.180 of 2019,
dated 09.09.2019, stood instituted at the behest of the registration of the complaint by the respondent no.2, as against the present applicants, who are the named accused persons, therein, for their alleged involvement in commission of the offences under sections 498A, 323 and 504 of IPC,
and under sections  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

As a consequence of the culmination of the investigation, the proceedings of the Criminal Case No.352 of 2021, "State Vs. Parag Verma and others", stood registered before the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun, and the same is pending consideration, on which the present applicants have been summoned by an order dated 08.01.2021.

entities.text: State Vs. Parag Verma and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: By the previous order, the parties were called upon to participate in the proceedings, through video conferencing for the reason being that it was reported by the Mediator, that the mediation proceedings had remained unsuccessful.
Hence, the matter was required to be considered on the compounding application, which was subsequently filed on 09.08.2023.

The complainant had participated in the proceedings through video conferencing, and she has been identified by the learned counsel Shri Akshay Pradhan, so the applicants too had participated through video C482/1896/2021 on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16935263/
1 conferencing, except for the applicant no.1, who is present in the court in person, and they too have duly identified by the learned counsel for the applicants.

This Court had interacted with the complainant, and the complainant has admitted the fact that they have jointly preferred the proceedings under section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act, which has been registered as Case No.524 of 2023, which upon its admission on 13.03.2023, is pending consideration before the competent court, and as a consequence thereto, out of the total permanent alimony of Rupees Five Lakh; Rupees Two Lakh Fifty Thousand Only, has already been remitted in the first motion, and the balance amount is due to be paid by applicant no.1, when the second motion is carried, before the Principal Judge, Family Court, Meerut.

The parties to the C482 application since have jointly made a statement, and particularly, the complainant/respondent no.2, that in case if the proceedings of the criminal case are hereby dropped, she may not be having any grievances, as such, because all her scores which are left to be settled are required to be settled in the proceedings under section 13B of the Act.
Owing to the aforesaid statement made by the complainant, since now she has voluntarily participating in the proceedings under section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act, coupled with the statements made by the respective applicants, in the compounding application, the same is accepted, and as a consequence thereto, the proceedings of the Criminal Case No.352 of 2021, "State Vs. Parag Verma and others", pending consideration before the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Dehradun, would hereby stand quashed, and as a result thereto the criminal case too would hereby stand dropped, leaving all the contentions of the parties to be decided in the proceedings under section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act.

entities.text: State Vs. Parag Verma and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Subject to the aforesaid, the C482 application stands closed.

(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 11.08.2023 NR C482/1896/2021 on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16935263/
